'''2009 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 8–11 October 2009, at the Clarion Hotel in Princeton, New Jersey, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=353</ref><ref name="awards">https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/</ref> Published lists are the Day 2, Day 3, and Team Tournament PDFs on the Players Committee 2009 decklists desk (no Day 1 PDF was published). [[Brian Hunter]] defeated [[Justin Desai]] in the final.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 8–11 October 2009
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
